title: Yodl vs Pumble for HIPAA teams (2026)
snippet:
No free plan or trial | Free plan with unlimited users; 7-day free trial of paid features without a credit card |

| API | $20 a month per workspace (REST API, webhooks, bot users) | Yes; plan availability not stated |

As of November 2026, Pumble's Free plan is $0 for an unlimited number of users, with 10 GB per workspace, unlimited message history and up to 3 apps. Pro is $2.49 per seat per month on annual billing or $2.99 monthly, with 10 GB per seat and up to 10 apps. Business is $3.99 annual or $4.99 monthly with 20 GB per seat and unlimited apps. Enterprise is $6.99 annual or $7.99 monthly with 100 GB per seat. A CAKE.com Bundle at $12.99 annual or $15.99 monthly per user adds Clockify and Plaky to Pumble Enterprise. Paid features come with a 7-day free trial, no credit card needed. Prices change, so verify them on Pumble's site.
For five people, Pumble Free is $0. Pumble Pro is $12.45 a month on annual billing or $14.95 monthly, and Business is $19.95 or $24.95.
Yodl is $10 a month for one location, with 5 users and 20 GB of file storage included. Extra users are $2 each per month. Each additional location is another $10 a month with 5 more users and 20 more GB. API access is $20 a month per workspace. There is a 14-day free trial, and you can cancel any month.

Pumble covers the basics well: unlimited users and unlimited message history on Free, channels, direct messages and threads, voice and video calls, file sharing with per-seat storage, native Clockify and Plaky integrations, an API, and data regions and admin controls on the higher tiers.

As of November 2026, Pumble Free is $0 for unlimited users; Pro is $2.49 per seat per month on annual billing, so $12.45 a month for 5, or $14.95 monthly. Verify on Pumble's site.

title: Pumble Pricing 2026
snippet:
Pumble offers **4 pricing editions**, starting from **$0** to **$6.99**. Pumble pricing tiers are designed to support different usage levels and team sizes. Pumble does not offer a **free trial**.

---
Free — $0
PRO — $2.49 / 1 user Per Month
Business — $3.99 / 1 user Per Month
Enterprise — $6.99 / 1 user Per Month
Rated 4.5 / 5

Yes. According to G2 data, Pumble offers a free plan with limited features. Users can upgrade to paid plans for additional capabilities. Visit the seller's official pricing page to compare plan options and features.

Pumble's free tier is notably generous: unlimited message history, unlimited users, 1:1 voice and video calls, file sharing, and 10GB total storage. G2 reviewers frequently highlight unlimited message history as a key free-tier advantage over competitors. The main limitations driving upgrades are group video and voice meetings, screen sharing, and storage — all locked behind paid tiers. Pumble's Pro plan ($2.49/month) unlocks group meetings, screen sharing, and 10GB storage per user. Pumble's Business plan ($3.99/month) adds guest access, permissions, and user groups. Pumble's Enterprise plan ($6.99/month) includes SSO, data retention, and 100GB storage per seat.
